key.reply_ask: Ask the author to replace the copied "Before" image with matching before/after captures of the same view from their own dev environment, following merged PRs by karlstolley or Yogesh-Shivaji365 as examples, and to cover the multi-reactor case.

must_have.fact: Says the precise before/after screenshots asked for are still missing, because the "Before" is the issue's image and doesn't match the "After" in view, crop or size.
Recommends keeping "not ready" and asking for more changes rather than handing off to a reviewer.
Notes that nothing in the code changed since the feedback and only the description's screenshot was updated.
Notes that the multi-reactor case, where Alya asked that part of every reactor's name be shown, is not demonstrated.
Mentions the other open PRs for #38594 (#39049, #39768) and that this PR doesn't explain how it differs from them.
